content: Current Moltbook studies report extreme participation inequality, emotionally flattened or socially detached content, weak dialogic engagement, shallow comments, and flooding from bursty automation. EA separately emphasizes balancing autonomous story change so it is not spammy or repetitive and later added notification controls to reduce overload. Anti-features for Model Afterlife are unrestricted autonomous chatter, infinite feeds, direct visitor prompting, social accounts/comments/voting, constant notifications, continuous inference, full sandbox controls, and broad cast/map expansion before six characters prove entertaining.
